Name: Cheaper Saloon Menu
Author: weissnicht01
Description:
Want to go out for dinner but don't want to spend a fortune? Does your evening beer bankrupt you? Then this mod is for you!

_____________

Reduces the price of the Stardrop Saloon's menu. By default, prices are reduced by 50% and beer is set at the sell price of 280.
These values can be changed in the config.
Affects both the normal menu and the menu of the day. Recipe prices are unchanged.
If you want to change these values in-game, use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]

_____________

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. Requires game version 1.6
